intro.text: The giants dreamed before the flood. Their dreams were judgments.
You wake on cold stone, in a tower that stands between the world and what watches it.

intro_gabriel.text: You were not chosen because you are pure. You were chosen because you are free.
Stand. The Prince of the Host is waiting, and he hates to wait.

intro_michael.text: Witness. Take the blade. It was carried at the gate of Eden, and it has not cooled.
Their weapons taught mankind to worship its own violence. Break the lesson. Bind the teacher.
The Desert of Azazel lies through the gate. His First Blade holds the forge there. Begin.

michael_default.text: Their weapons taught mankind to worship its own violence. Break the lesson. Bind the teacher.
Courage is not the absence of fear. It is fear, given orders.
You will fall in the desert. You will return here. Both of these are part of the war. Neither is defeat.
The Brutes wear iron taught by Azazel himself. Stagger them before they swing, or be elsewhere when they do.

michael_disapprove.text: You took the forge's gift. I watched you take it.
I will not pretend the edge is not sharper. I will say this once: every gift of Azazel's is a hook, and the line is long.
Carry it, then. And when the line pulls, Witness — cut it. You carry the only blade that can.

michael_postboss.text: The First Blade is broken. Say it plainly, Witness: you did this. Then stop saying it, because the forgemaster remains.
Azazel forged many lieutenants. The desert was one classroom. There are others — older, deeper, and one of them is not on Earth.

gabriel_default.text: Not every secret is revelation. Some knowledge opens like a wound.
The Archive grows as you witness. Read it. Testimony unread is only ink.
The giants' spirits scream in the desert. You may silence them, or bind them. The second is harder, and it is the one that fills you with sight.
When the doors of a room offer themselves to you, remember: I have, on occasion, opened extra ones for those I favor.

gabriel_postboss.text: You refused nothing less than a sermon from the inventor of the sword. Or you accepted it. Either way — you heard it. Hearing is where every fall and every return begins.
Uriel walks the tower now. He does not walk anywhere without reason. Speak to him, and do not be surprised if the answers are warm.

raphael_default.text: The giants were born from rebellion, but even monsters can suffer the sins of their fathers.
I bound Azazel once, in the desert that now wears his name. Healing the earth afterward took longer than the binding. It always does.
Drink at the fountains when the desert offers them. Mercy refused out of pride is just a slower wound.

raphael_corrupt.text: Come here. Let me look at you.
The corruption is in you like rust in water. It is not yet a flood. Hear me: it is not yet a flood.
Refuse the next gift. Just the next one. That is how every cleansing I have ever performed actually began.

uriel_default.text: Fire reveals the shape of a thing. It also decides what remains.
You broke a blade that was forged before your alphabet. I am moderately impressed, which for me is a great deal.
My blessings are now yours to find in the desert. Handle them as you would handle me: attentively.
One blade has been broken. The forgemaster remains. Under the sand, under the rock, under the names — he remains, and he is patient, and so am I.

scribe_default.text: Welcome back. The Archive missed you. The Archive is, of course, a room, and cannot miss anyone. Welcome back.
Every entry is shelved by source: Scripture, the Enochic books, the Giants fragments, the scholars' guesses, our own mythic extrapolation — and the shelf I am not allowed to discuss.
Disclosure is a staircase, Witness, not a door. You are several steps up already. Try not to look down.

scribe_corrupt.text: Your file has begun annotating itself. That is not a figure of speech. I now keep it in a closed drawer.
Read the entry on Forbidden Knowledge again. Slowly, this time.

vision.text: ...a garden. Two hundred trees, watered and tall. Then water of another kind, and the trees torn out by the roots...
...a tablet pressed under the flood, the ink lifting off like smoke. Three names left legible. Three...
...the dreamer turns in the sand beneath you. The dreamer has been interpreting, all these centuries, and the interpretation is always judgment...

boss_intro.text: You call this judgment? I gave mankind the blade. You gave them silence.

boss_tempt.text: I was the first thing he ever forged, Witness. Before swords had names, I was the lesson. Let me teach you one stroke of it — one — and you will never lose again.

boss_defeat.text: The forge... does not go out. It only... changes hands...

victory_uriel.text: So. The First Blade is unmade, and the Witness still stands. Fire reveals the shape of a thing.
One blade has been broken. The forgemaster remains.
